title: Whose Voice Is in the Policy Room?
assessmentMethod: Private reflective journal entry, not scored

body.en: Climate and disaster policies decide where shelters go, how warnings are broadcast, and how relief is distributed — decisions that land differently depending on whether disability was actually considered while they were being written, not added afterward as a footnote. Ghana has disability rights frameworks in place; the harder question is whether persons with disabilities are actually in the room when climate-specific policy gets made, not just consulted after a draft already exists. Have you ever seen a policy, rule, or plan that looked reasonable on paper but clearly wasn't written with someone like you — or someone you know — in mind? What was missing?
